issues.legal_issue: Whether a conveyance transferred ownership rights or only leasehold rights.
Whether leasehold rights were validly transferred in accordance with the lease’s requirement of written approval.
Whether a breach of the lease’s transfer conditions determined the lease.
Whether the lease ended upon expiry of its initial term.
Whether continued possession and acceptance of rent entitled the lessee to protection under the doctrine of holding over.
Whether the lease continued through acquiescence or the parties’ conduct, and whether that continuation conferred rights under the applicable land-reform legislation.
Whether the predecessor acquired occupancy-tenant status under the applicable tenancy law and consequently acquired the status of a sirdar.
Whether the predecessor acquired sirdar status through another statutory route, including as a hereditary tenant or government lessee.
